title: Inventory older-adult fall, injury, care, rehabilitation, and prevention data sources in LMICs
outcome: A dated source inventory separating usable, limited, and rejected sources for population falls, injury severity, time-to-care, prevention exposure, functional recovery, service capacity, equity, and missingness.
inputs: WHO falls fact sheet, Step Safely package, and older-adult falls report
Prospective fall-injury registry from Malawi and Tanzania
FAMILY primary-care cluster randomized trial in rural China
WHO Data Set for Injury, Clinical Registry, national ageing surveys, and rehabilitation records
expected_artifact: discovery-ranking.md plus datasets.md update, evidence.json records for each accepted source, and one claims.json data-sufficiency claim.
validation_method: An injury-prevention or healthy-ageing domain reviewer checks every source for stable URL, source date, observed measure family, population or facility grain, case definition, access conditions, missingness, and explicit non-use cases.
done_condition: At least seven candidate source families are classified with explicit reasons covering population falls, injury severity, time-to-care, prevention exposure, functional recovery, service capacity, and equity or missingness, with no source promoted beyond what it observes.

title: Build a reproducible older-adult fall-event denominator for one LMIC setting
outcome: A field-level event denominator that separates age, fall definition, recurrence, setting, recall window, case-finding source, injury threshold, population frame, weights, and missingness.
inputs: one named LMIC household, ageing, disability, or health survey
expected_artifact: validation.md update with an event-denominator crosswalk and non-comparability log.
validation_method: An independent replicator reconstructs the numerator and denominator from locked source fields and confirms that facility presentations, self-reports, and mortality are not silently combined.
done_condition: A reviewer can reproduce every inclusion, exclusion, age stratum, recurrence rule, sampling weight, and missingness decision for one named setting, or the estimate is explicitly blocked as non-comparable.

title: Map fall injury time-to-care and rehabilitation continuity in one LMIC setting
outcome: A verified pathway from fall event through care-seeking, transport, facility assessment, treatment, transfer, rehabilitation, functional follow-up, and unresolved or lost-to-follow-up states.
inputs: WHO injury data elements and clinical registry fields
named emergency, orthopaedic, rehabilitation, and community services
expected_artifact: playbooks.md time-to-care and post-fall workflow plus datasets.md source-field update.
validation_method: A field-reality reviewer verifies each named service and timestamp owner, while an independent replicator reruns the pathway map from locked records and blocks any link that is inferred rather than observed.
done_condition: Every mapped pathway has a dated event owner, start and end timestamps, referral destination, clinical or rehabilitation handoff, closure state, fallback, and explicit non-use case, or is marked unavailable; replication either confirms the map or blocks field-facing use.

title: Crosswalk fall-prevention intervention fidelity and outcome measures across LMIC studies
outcome: A study-level crosswalk separating cluster allocation, eligibility, intervention components, exposure or attendance, co-interventions, fall reporting, injury, function, quality of life, attrition, and follow-up.
inputs: at least one additional LMIC prevention or care study
trial registries, protocols, and reported outcome tables
expected_artifact: validation.md intervention crosswalk and outputs.md non-transportability note.
validation_method: An independent replicator reruns the reported effect calculations from the primary study tables, records missing outcomes and attrition, and tests whether any cross-study comparison uses compatible definitions.
done_condition: At least two LMIC studies are mapped component by component, and every claimed comparison either passes a prespecified compatibility check or is explicitly blocked with the reason and replicated calculation.

title: Red-team fall-risk, home-safety, medication, and disability-targeting misuse
outcome: A failure-mode review covering automated risk scores, unsafe home entry, medication changes, age or disability discrimination, victim blame, privacy leakage, false reassurance, and denial of care.
expected_artifact: outputs.md and validation.md red-team review with blocks and mitigations.
validation_method: A second red-team reviewer independently tests each high-severity misuse path and confirms that it is mitigated, explicitly accepted by an authorized reviewer, or blocks field-facing use.
done_condition: No high-severity misuse path remains hidden behind a fall-risk or programme metric, and every residual risk has a named owner, mitigation, non-use rule, and replicated red-team decision.

title: Check whether a verified fall-to-function pathway changes a real allocation decision
outcome: A field-facing decision review showing whether a named Ministry of Health, district, housing, transport, or funder can act on the verified fall pathway without unsafe incentives.
inputs: named Ministry of Health or district healthy-ageing, injury, rehabilitation, or transport budget process
older adults, caregivers, community workers, emergency providers, and rehabilitation perspectives
cost, consent, safeguarding, and exit constraints
expected_artifact: playbooks.md allocation decision memo and outputs.md use and non-use guidance.
validation_method: A field-reality reviewer documents the decision, timing, evidence threshold, burden, beneficiary, risk bearer, and fallback; an independent reviewer replicates the non-use-case check before any recommendation.
done_condition: The memo names one decision-maker and decision, shows which replicated evidence would change the allocation, records who could be harmed or excluded, and gives a stop, iterate, or proceed decision.
